name: Influenza Vaccination Coverage, Region (HCEZ)
rowLabel: Weekly influenza vaccination coverage for a subpopulation

Metadata.Time Period: July 2021 through the most recent date shown

columns.name: Week End
columns.description: End date of the week. Dates are based on standard MMWR weeks as defined by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: Season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated, beginning during MMWR week 27 and ending with week 26 of the following year.

columns.name: Age Group
columns.description: Values used are: 0-17, 18-64, 65+, 18+, Unknown, All Ages

columns.name: Race/Ethnicity
columns.description: Values used are: Latinx; Black, non-Latinx; White, non-Latinx; Asian, non-Latinx; Other, non-Latinx; Unknown; All Race/Ethnicities

columns.name: Population Size
columns.description: Number of people in the group based on the specified combination equity zone and age.

columns.name: Count
columns.description: Number of people in the specified group that achieved the vaccination status.

columns.name: Percent
columns.description: Percent of people in the specified group that achieved the vaccination status.

columns.name: HCEZ Centroid
columns.description: A point that falls inside the Equity Zone, usually the centroid but adjusted if the centroid would fall outside the region. It is present to facilitate geographic analysis.

columns.name: MMWR Week
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: Week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: Current Season Week End
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week for the current season.

columns.name: Community Areas
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Community Areas' (vrxf-vc4k) the point in column 'region_centroid' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
